svg.title: The Bottle of Sack, Sutton Coldfield – Wetherspoon carpet (seamless tile)
svg.desc: Seamless repeat of the gold trellis carpet. All lines lie on one rhombic grid: two families of parallel lines at ±22.38° to the vertical (slope 7/17), 70 units apart horizontally, crossing every 170 units vertically. The tile is 17 × 7 rhombi (1190 × 1190) and holds two half-drop motifs: nested diamonds made of a 3-line chevron bundle meeting a 4-line bundle spaced 1-2-1. Geometry extends past the viewBox and is clipped by it, so every line and fleck continues exactly across all four edges.
